subtopics.label: COPD and Airway Biology
subtopics.description: Research on the cellular and molecular biology of chronic obstructive pulmonary disease, including airway epithelial cell dysfunction, club cell biology, lymphatic involvement, sphingolipid metabolism, smoking-induced dysregulation, and COPD comorbidities and outcomes.
subtopics.short_description: Cellular and molecular mechanisms of COPD, including airway epithelial dysfunction, sphingolipid metabolism, and smoking-induced dysregulation.

subtopics.label: Interstitial Lung Disease and Pulmonary Fibrosis
subtopics.description: Research on interstitial lung diseases including idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis, hypersensitivity pneumonitis, nonspecific interstitial pneumonia, and interstitial lung abnormalities, covering pathogenesis, biomarkers, quality of life, and clinical management.
subtopics.short_description: Pathogenesis, biomarkers, and clinical management of IPF, hypersensitivity pneumonitis, and related interstitial lung diseases.

subtopics.label: Asthma and Allergic Airway Disease
subtopics.description: Research on asthma pathogenesis and treatment, including sphingolipid metabolism, type 2 airway inflammation, innate lymphoid cells, allergen exposure, cytokine signaling, and genetic risk factors for airway hyperreactivity.
subtopics.short_description: Mechanisms and treatment of asthma, including type 2 inflammation, innate lymphoid cells, allergen exposure, and genetic risk factors.

subtopics.label: COVID-19 Respiratory Pathophysiology and Critical Illness
subtopics.description: Research on the pulmonary and systemic pathophysiology of severe COVID-19, including ARDS, vascular injury, complement activation, cytokine profiles, barotrauma, mechanical ventilation management, and organ dysfunction trajectories in critically ill patients.
subtopics.short_description: Pulmonary and systemic pathophysiology of severe COVID-19, including ARDS, vascular injury, cytokine profiles, and ventilator management.

subtopics.label: COVID-19 Clinical Outcomes, Risk Factors, and Treatment
subtopics.description: Research on clinical characteristics, risk factors, comorbidities, and treatment strategies for hospitalized COVID-19 patients, including antiviral and immunomodulatory therapies, variant severity comparisons, and predictive models for deterioration and mortality.
subtopics.short_description: Risk factors, comorbidities, antiviral and immunomodulatory therapies, and predictive models for hospitalized COVID-19 patients.

subtopics.label: Long COVID and Post-Acute Sequelae of SARS-CoV-2
subtopics.description: Research on post-acute sequelae of SARS-CoV-2 infection (PASC/Long COVID), including symptom characterization, subphenotyping, risk factor identification, cognitive and cardiopulmonary manifestations, and disparities across demographic groups.
subtopics.short_description: Symptom characterization, subphenotyping, and cardiopulmonary and cognitive manifestations of PASC across demographic groups.

subtopics.label: Respiratory Infections and Pneumonia Pathogenesis
subtopics.description: Research on bacterial, viral, and fungal respiratory infections including pneumococcal pneumonia, influenza, Streptococcus, Acinetobacter, Chlamydia, and human metapneumovirus, covering host immune responses, pathogen mechanisms, and treatment strategies.
subtopics.short_description: Host immune responses and pathogen mechanisms in bacterial, viral, and fungal respiratory infections including pneumococcal pneumonia and influenza.

subtopics.label: Pulmonary Hypertension and Pulmonary Vascular Disease
subtopics.description: Research on pulmonary hypertension and pulmonary vascular disease, including diagnosis, risk stratification, echocardiographic assessment, right ventricular function, chronic thromboembolic pulmonary hypertension, and outcomes across pulmonary vascular disease subtypes.
subtopics.short_description: Diagnosis, risk stratification, right ventricular function, and outcomes across pulmonary hypertension and vascular disease subtypes.

subtopics.label: Pulmonary Embolism Diagnosis and Treatment
subtopics.description: Research on acute pulmonary embolism management including catheter-directed thrombolysis, mechanical thrombectomy, surgical embolectomy, risk stratification tools, anticoagulation strategies, and outcomes in diverse patient populations.
subtopics.short_description: Acute pulmonary embolism management including catheter-directed thrombolysis, thrombectomy, risk stratification, and anticoagulation strategies.

subtopics.label: Lung Transplantation and Perioperative Management
subtopics.description: Research on lung transplantation outcomes, perioperative management, primary graft dysfunction, ECMO use, cystic fibrosis retransplantation, cytomegalovirus immunity, and lymphatic anastomosis in transplant recipients.
subtopics.short_description: Transplant outcomes, primary graft dysfunction, ECMO use, CMV immunity, and perioperative management in lung transplant recipients.

subtopics.label: Mechanical Ventilation and ICU Management
subtopics.description: Research on mechanical ventilation practices, sedation, vasopressor use, tracheostomy, ICU staffing, sepsis management, and outcomes in critically ill adult and pediatric patients.
subtopics.short_description: Ventilation practices, sedation, vasopressor use, tracheostomy, and outcomes in critically ill adult and pediatric patients.

subtopics.label: Airway Epithelium Biology and SARS-CoV-2 Infection Mechanisms
subtopics.description: Research on airway epithelial cell biology, ACE2 receptor expression, organoid models of SARS-CoV-2 infection, viral entry mechanisms, and host transcriptomic responses in the respiratory tract.
subtopics.short_description: ACE2 expression, organoid models, and host transcriptomic responses underlying SARS-CoV-2 infection in the respiratory tract.

subtopics.label: Lung Cancer Biology and Surgical Treatment
subtopics.description: Research on lung cancer biology including tumor microenvironment, oncogenic drivers, immune evasion, and surgical treatment approaches including lobectomy versus sublobar resection for early-stage non-small cell lung cancer.
subtopics.short_description: Tumor microenvironment, oncogenic drivers, immune evasion, and surgical approaches for early-stage non-small cell lung cancer.

subtopics.label: Sleep Apnea and Respiratory Physiology
subtopics.description: Research on obstructive sleep apnea including cardiovascular risk, platelet activation, maternal outcomes, CPAP therapy, and related respiratory physiological measurements including respiratory muscle strength and cough assessment.
subtopics.short_description: Cardiovascular risk, CPAP therapy, platelet activation, and respiratory muscle physiology in obstructive sleep apnea.

subtopics.label: Chest Imaging and Pulmonary Diagnostics
subtopics.description: Research on chest imaging modalities including CT, MRI, X-ray, and ultrasound for diagnosis and monitoring of pulmonary conditions including ILD, pneumothorax, COVID-19 pneumonia, and lung cancer screening.
subtopics.short_description: CT, MRI, X-ray, and ultrasound for diagnosis and monitoring of ILD, pneumothorax, COVID-19 pneumonia, and lung cancer.

subtopics.label: COVID-19 Cardiac and Thrombotic Complications
subtopics.description: Research on cardiovascular manifestations of COVID-19 including myocarditis, atrial arrhythmias, thrombotic events, troponin elevation, and anticoagulation management in hospitalized patients.
subtopics.short_description: Myocarditis, arrhythmias, thrombotic events, troponin elevation, and anticoagulation management in hospitalized COVID-19 patients.

subtopics.label: COVID-19 Epigenomics, Multi-omics, and Molecular Signatures
subtopics.description: Studies applying DNA methylation profiling, machine learning on epigenetic data, and integrative multi-omics approaches to identify molecular signatures of COVID-19 severity and outcomes.
subtopics.short_description: DNA methylation profiling and integrative multi-omics approaches identifying molecular signatures of COVID-19 severity and outcomes.

subtopics.label: COVID-19 Hospital Operations, Surge Capacity, and Preparedness
subtopics.description: Research on hospital and ICU operational responses to COVID-19 including surge capacity planning, rapid ICU expansion, staff redeployment, and preparedness protocols.
subtopics.short_description: Hospital and ICU operational responses to COVID-19, including surge planning, rapid expansion, and staff redeployment protocols.

subtopics.label: Pediatric COVID-19 and SARS-CoV-2 in Children
subtopics.description: Studies examining COVID-19 clinical presentation, hospitalization indications, and outcomes specifically in pediatric populations including the Omicron wave and croup presentations.
subtopics.short_description: Clinical presentation, hospitalization indications, and outcomes of COVID-19 in children, including Omicron-era and croup presentations.

subtopics.label: Tuberculosis and Mycobacterial Infections
subtopics.description: Research on tuberculosis treatment, drug regimens, host-directed therapy, diagnostic methods, and co-infections with mycobacterial species including novel second-line regimens.
subtopics.short_description: TB treatment regimens, host-directed therapy, diagnostic methods, and co-infections with mycobacterial species.

subtopics.label: ICU Quality Improvement, Patient Safety, and Clinical Operations
subtopics.description: Studies addressing ICU quality improvement initiatives, patient safety practices, staffing ratios, clinical databases, and operational tools to enhance critical care delivery.
subtopics.short_description: Quality improvement initiatives, patient safety practices, staffing ratios, and operational tools for critical care delivery.

subtopics.label: Extracorporeal Membrane Oxygenation (ECMO) and Extracorporeal Support
subtopics.description: Research on ECMO use in adults and children including hemostatic management, renal replacement therapy during ECMO, temperature management, and outcomes in respiratory failure.
subtopics.short_description: ECMO outcomes in adults and children, including hemostatic management, renal replacement, and temperature management in respiratory failure.

subtopics.label: Lung Cancer Surgical and Perioperative Management
subtopics.description: Studies on perioperative assessment, pulmonary function testing before resection, postoperative complications, and surgical outcomes in lung cancer patients including during COVID-19.
subtopics.short_description: Preoperative pulmonary function assessment, postoperative complications, and surgical outcomes in lung cancer resection patients.

subtopics.label: Lung Cancer Immunotherapy and Targeted Therapy
subtopics.description: Research on immune checkpoint inhibitors, anti-PD-L1 therapy combined with radiation, molecular biomarkers of treatment response, and novel drug delivery approaches for lung cancer.
subtopics.short_description: Checkpoint inhibitors, anti-PD-L1 combined with radiation, molecular biomarkers of response, and novel drug delivery for lung cancer.

subtopics.label: Pediatric Critical Care and Neonatal Respiratory Management
subtopics.description: Research on critical care management in pediatric and neonatal populations including delirium, sedation practices, unplanned extubations, CPAP in preterm infants, and tracheostomy care.
subtopics.short_description: Delirium, sedation, unplanned extubations, CPAP in preterm infants, and tracheostomy care in pediatric and neonatal populations.

subtopics.label: SARS-CoV-2 Biology, Animal Models, and Experimental Therapeutics
subtopics.description: Studies using stem cell models, organoids, animal models, and in situ detection methods to investigate SARS-CoV-2 infection mechanisms, immune responses, and experimental therapeutic interventions.
subtopics.short_description: Organoid, stem cell, and animal models investigating SARS-CoV-2 infection mechanisms, immune responses, and experimental therapeutics.

subtopics.label: Antimicrobial Resistance and Antibiotic Stewardship
subtopics.description: Research on carbapenem-resistant pathogens, polymyxin breakpoints, hospital-acquired and ventilator-associated pneumonia treatment algorithms, and clinical outcomes of resistant infections.
subtopics.short_description: Carbapenem-resistant pathogens, polymyxin breakpoints, ventilator-associated pneumonia algorithms, and outcomes of resistant infections.

subtopics.label: Thoracic Trauma, Surgery, and Perioperative Respiratory Complications
subtopics.description: Studies on rib fixation in trauma, chest tube management, diaphragm preservation in aortic surgery, respiratory complications after cervical spine surgery, and perioperative respiratory outcomes.
subtopics.short_description: Rib fixation, chest tube management, diaphragm preservation, and perioperative respiratory outcomes in thoracic and spinal surgery.

subtopics.label: Smoking, Vaping, and Occupational Respiratory Exposures
subtopics.description: Research on electronic cigarette use in adolescents and adults, oral and respiratory effects of vaping, occupational dust exposures, and tobacco-related respiratory disease.
subtopics.short_description: E-cigarette use in adolescents and adults, oral and respiratory effects of vaping, and occupational dust-related respiratory disease.

subtopics.label: COVID-19 Neurological Manifestations and Brain Effects
subtopics.description: Studies on neurological presentations of COVID-19 including posterior reversible encephalopathy syndrome, neurological symptoms as primary presentation, and brain fog in long COVID.
subtopics.short_description: Neurological presentations of COVID-19, including encephalopathy, brain fog in long COVID, and neurological symptoms as primary presentation.
